title: Where Are You Going?
blurb: Asked with the specific menace of somebody who already knows you have nowhere to be. It is an interception sound: catching a friend edging towards the door at a party, spotting somebody trying to leave a meeting early, or addressing a cat halfway through a window it should not be able to fit through. The question is entirely rhetorical, and everybody involved understands that. Drop it over any footage of a subject attempting a quiet exit. You are not, in fact, going anywhere.
